1. LUNCH CLUB — Please bring a spoon and a bowl. We have enough plates and forks for everyone.

2. FRUIT TABLE — You may take one apple or one banana. Please leave some fruit for the next class.

3. Hi Sam, I have some cheese but no bread. Can you bring a few pieces for our lunch? Lily

4. JUICE BOTTLES — Write your name on your bottle. Put it beside your lunch box, not on the floor.

5. SCHOOL KITCHEN — Please wash your hands before you mix the food. Ask a teacher before you bake.

6. TODAY’S SNACK — Fresh grapes are on the blue plate. Please use a spoon for the yogurt.
